result.quote: There he made a covenant with them and put them under oath. He showed them the king’s son
result.reason: The covenant and oath are both stated immediately before the son is shown, so the key is supported. The wording is grammatically awkward because it omits “the” before “commanders” and “king’s son,” and the commanders are described as being put under oath rather than independently swearing one. A clearer version is: “What two things did Jehoiada do with the commanders before showing them the king’s son?”
